messages.author: d26b604dbd744256
messages.subject: Problem with dateRangeInput
parts:
Hi
I am new in R shiny. I have created a script using "dateRangeInput". It works fine. However, when I am trying to change the time, script starts running before changing both start and end time and giving some error/warning messages because of the bad time values. At the end, it gives right plot. Any idea to get rid off this problem. Here is the few necessary lines from ui.R and server.r.
 
ui.R

dateRangeInput("dates",
               "Date range",
               start = "1988-01-01",
               #end = as.character(Sys.Date())),
               end = "2010-12-31",
               min    = "1988-01-01",
               max    = "2010-12-31",
               separator = " - ")

server.R

x1 <- as.numeric(gsub("-", "", input$dates[1]))*100
x2 <- as.numeric(gsub("-", "", input$dates[2]))*100

W.df = subset(obsc.datain_short,date>= x1 & date<x2)

with regards
-Deb

messages.subject: Re: Problem with dateRangeInput
parts:
Hi, Thanks for your response. Somehow it does not work. The problem I am having when I am trying to change the year, month and day.
For example: By default I plotted for 1988-01-01 to 2011-12-31 and now when I am trying change the time and delete 1988 and type 2005 to get the plot for 2005, as soon as I type 2, 0, 0 and 5, the script starts running and looking for following time 2-01-01, 20-01-01, 200-01-01 (which is unrealistic) before run for 2005-01-01. Any solution?

with regards
-Deb
